tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background, behind the storefront and the assistant.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the assistant panel, drawers, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Strips and wells: the status line, chip backgrounds, table headers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (inputs, quiet buttons, chips, steppers): at least 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on canvas, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (captions, SKUs, helper lines) on canvas, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour: primary buttons, links, the brand mark, selected states. Text in forest reads on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: forest-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of forest fills; the focus ring.

tokens.name: forest-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected chips and the 'held' state.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a forest or forest-strong fill.

tokens.name: lantern
tokens.usage: Secondary brand colour: highlight fills (the 'Recommended' badge, the active step in the waiting card, selected variant chip). A fill, never text.

tokens.name: lantern-soft
tokens.usage: Soft highlight behind changed values and tips.

tokens.name: on-lantern
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lantern fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: campfire
tokens.usage: Rare brand accent: promo tags ('New', 'Camp-to-desk') and the spark in the brand mark. Never for errors, warnings or stock.

tokens.name: on-campfire
tokens.usage: Text on a campfire fill.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Status 'In stock' / success: dot and word. Lake blue, so it is never confused with the forest brand green or told apart from red by hue alone.

tokens.name: status-ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind an 'In stock' or success notice.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Status 'Low stock' / caution: outlined dot and word.

tokens.name: status-warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a caution notice ('Only 48 at Indianapolis').

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: Status 'Out of stock' / error: dashed dot, icon and word. Crimson, darker than campfire, always with a word.

tokens.name: status-bad-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind an error notice.

tokens.name: receipt-paper
tokens.usage: Background of receipt badges and the receipt drawer: paper, slightly warmer than surface.

tokens.name: receipt-edge
tokens.usage: The dashed (perforated) edge of a receipt badge and the drawer's tear line.

tokens.name: receipt-ink
tokens.usage: Text on receipt-paper.

tokens.name: receipt-check
tokens.usage: The check mark on a receipt badge: proof the number was read from the database.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind the assistant and the receipt drawer.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Storefront page titles. Once per page.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Product names on cards; section titles inside an answer.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Found 2 chairs that match everything you asked for.
styles.usage: Answers, descriptions, everything a shopper reads.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Prices, totals and the one fact an answer is about.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: stock words, tags, table headers.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: SKUs, row keys and SQL inside receipts. Never for prose.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Elapsed time in the waiting card and the hold countdown (tabular figures).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to word; dot to stock word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows inside a card; chip and badge horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between answers in the conversation.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing on the storefront.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Receipt badges, tags, the mono row key.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, steppers, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the assistant panel, drawers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips (suggestion, choice, requirement, variant).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Product cards and notices: lifts them just off the surface.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The floating assistant panel and the receipt drawer.
